name: universal-caldav-calendar
description: An account-linked remote CalDAV calendar plugin for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Use any CalDAV calendar from ChatGPT and Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connect fruux or another public HTTPS CalDAV account once, then query and manage the same calendars from ChatGPT and Codex on any computer signed into your account.
defaultPrompt: Find a free two-hour slot next week.
Create a weekly recurring calendar event.
